calls.title: Growthbook <-> Orb
calls.summary: The team discussed key strategies for managing subscriptions and billing processes, focusing on maintaining daily seat synchronization with monthly reconciliation for enterprise and pro plans. A tiered pricing model is proposed to better handle users beyond the fixed number included and to improve reliability in seat count updates. Credit allocation for experiments was highlighted, allowing for annual credits with monthly overage charges, and flexible credit top-ups. The importance of event ingestion for license-based pricing was also emphasized, requiring user-level data. Furthermore, options for synchronizing invoices to HubSpot and automatic pricing adjustments during renewals were explored, addressing the ongoing challenge of balancing pricing flexibility with operational simplicity.
calls.keywords: Seat-based pricing, License-based pricing, Tiered pricing, Credit allocation, Webhooks, Plan version management
calls.action_items:
**Michael Knowlton**
Explore tiered pricing implementation in Orb for enterprise seats and test API handling of quantity updates for tiers (13:49)
Investigate adding user-level properties to events or sending daily seat usage events to support license-based pricing reconciliation (11:03)
Begin sending experiment start events to Orb to utilize license or credit allocations for billing (19:02)
Explore manual credit adjustments at the customer level for selling additional experiment start buckets, and invoice handling (22:04)
Verify webhook payload to confirm inclusion of billing and additional email recipients for usage alerts (25:23)
Implement webhook integration to sync invoice issuance events to HubSpot for sales tracking (26:50)
Determine plan version management strategy regarding subscription price overrides and renewals, considering phased plans or multiple versions (29:02)

**Anton Barun**
Provide guidance and documentation on tiered pricing, license-based pricing setup, and usage of credit ledgers and manual credit top-ups (00:00)
Assist with webhook setup details and examples for usage alerts and invoice notifications (25:50)
Be available for follow-up support via Slack for any issues or further questions Michael encounters (33:08)
